divergences.melt: MELT reduce_conditions refuses a missing or non-positive target; GOAL kill criterion 3
divergences.rule: declared measurement losses (specimen-lost, section-unreadable, not-measured) are excluded, listed and counted at section, track and condition level; above 20 % of tracks or of conditions is a block issue; a status change after an attempt is a changed targets file

divergences.melt: MELT block_level_issues has no boundary item
divergences.rule: a boundary that is not an etched fusion boundary is a block issue
a cross-section location near track ends or unstated is a block issue
beam profile top-hat or ring is a block issue; unknown is a label only

divergences.melt: MELT: initial temperature not released is a block issue
divergences.rule: a missing plate temperature refuses (PREHEAT_MISSING); nominal-ambient is labelled

divergences.melt: MELT registers thresholds and leverage cuts for Ti-6Al-4V and AlSi10Mg only
divergences.rule: thresholds and statistics registered for Ti-6Al-4V and AlSi10Mg are reused unchanged for 316L, IN718 and IN625 with a label; low cut 15 proposed for 316L and IN718; IN625 leverage is not evaluable (a step 5 qualifier); results are reported per alloy and never pooled (maintainer decision 2026-10-17); the G3o and G3s objectives keep their registered scope

track-not-formed counts as APE +inf for every arm
research band coverage and consistency counts (protocol 2 only; inactive here)
